name: The Council of Four
oracle_text:
Whenever a player draws their second card during their turn, you draw a card.
Whenever a player casts their second spell during their turn, you create a 2/2 white Knight creature token.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a player casts their second spell during their turn, you create a 2/2 white Knight creature token.

needs.what: A per-player ordinal on the SPELL_CAST event, so a `spell_cast` trigger can ask at queue time "that was that player's Nth spell this turn" -- exactly what `data["nth"]` already is on DRAW, and answerable the same way. `state._fold` already bumps `ledger.spells_cast[pid]` on every SPELL_CAST (src/automtg/engine/state.py:681-687), so the work is: compute the post-bump ordinal where the event is emitted (`game.py:672`, `triggers.fire(state, EventType.SPELL_CAST, ..., nth=...)`), and relax the loader guard at src/automtg/cards/loader/__init__.py:1406 -- `if model.trigger.nth is not None and model.trigger.event != "draw"` -- to admit `spell_cast`. `triggers._matches` needs no change at all: its ordinal test (src/automtg/engine/triggers.py:913) is already written against `event.data.get("nth")` for any event. The ordinal must be per **player**, not per ability controller, because the printed clause is "a player casts *their* second spell" and every seat gets its own count. This one change turns on the whole "whenever a player casts their Nth spell each turn" family at once -- The Council of Four, Ledger Shredder, Vega, and (with the filtered-subset half that Esper Sentinel's record also asks for) every "first noncreature spell each turn" tax.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Three near misses, each checked in source. (1) `TriggerSpec.nth` asks precisely the right question and has nothing to read: DRAW is the only event that carries an ordinal (written by `primitives.draw_cards`, src/automtg/engine/primitives.py:72-80), and the loader refuses `nth` outright on any other event with "'nth' only means anything on a draw trigger" (src/automtg/cards/loader/__init__.py:1406-1415), so the card does not even load. (2) `TriggerSpec.max_per_turn` is a cap counted per permanent in `triggers._queue`, so it says "this ability triggers only once each turn" and not "a player's second spell" -- it would fire on the first spell of the turn instead of the second, and in a pod it would spend its one allowance on whichever seat cast first. (3) The trigger `condition` form -- `cmp` of `{"spells_cast_this_turn": {"player": {"binding": "event_player"}}}` against `{"const": 2}`, which `values.py:448-458` really can compute per player -- is the near miss this codebase documents at length as wrong (`carddef.TriggerSpec.nth`, src/automtg/engine/carddef.py:439-453): an intervening-if is re-asked on resolution (603.4, `stack.resolve_top`) and the tally has moved by then. The caster casts their second spell, the trigger queues with the tally at 2, they hold priority and cast a third in response; the re-check reads 3 and the ability resolves `skipped="condition"`, so the Knight is never made in one of this card's most ordinary lines. Loosening to `>=` fires on every spell from the second on, which is a strictly better card. Only a queue-time predicate on the event is both right at queue time and stable, and that is what `nth` is.
needs.blocks_only: the second printed line; the rest of the card is expressible today

notes: This is the card's ONLY blocker, and it is one line of engine work plus one relaxed guard. Everything else already exists. The token is not a gap: `knight_2_2_w` is "2/2 white Knight creature", exactly what is printed (`knight_2_2_w_vigilance` is the trap and is a different token). "During their turn" is not a gap either: it is `{"is_active_player": {"binding": "event_player"}}` as a trigger `condition`, the shape Wedding Ring already ships in data/cards/auto/templates.cards.json, and "a player" is `controller: "any"` (schema.py:247). The first line is fully expressible today -- a `draw` trigger with `nth: 2`, which templates.cards.json already ships. The whole card, once SPELL_CAST carries an ordinal: {"card": {"id": "the_council_of_four", "name": "The Council of Four", "oracle_text": "Whenever a player draws their second card during their turn, you draw a card.\nWhenever a player casts their second spell during their turn, you create a 2/2 white Knight creature token.", "mana_cost": "{3}{W}{U}", "types": ["Creature"], "supertypes": ["Legendary"], "subtypes": ["Human", "Noble"], "power": 0, "toughness": 8, "colors": ["U", "W"], "color_identity": ["U", "W"], "abilities": [{"kind": "triggered", "text": "Whenever a player draws their second card during their turn, you draw a card.", "trigger": {"event": "draw", "controller": "any", "nth": 2, "condition": {"is_active_player": {"binding": "event_player"}}}, "effects": [{"op": "draw", "amount": {"const": 1}, "player": "you"}]}, {"kind": "triggered", "text": "Whenever a player casts their second spell during their turn, you create a 2/2 white Knight creature token.", "trigger": {"event": "spell_cast", "controller": "any", "nth": 2, "condition": {"is_active_player": {"binding": "event_player"}}}, "effects": [{"op": "create_token", "token": "knight_2_2_w", "amount": {"const": 1}}]}]}, "expectation": {"zone": "battlefield", "battlefield_count": 33}}. The expectation is the weak fallback on purpose: the sandbox casts this card and stops, so nothing draws a second card and no second spell is cast after it -- neither trigger can fire in that position, and asserting a drawn card or a Knight token would be asserting a trigger that never happens.
